score_notes.A: Front matter complete (subtitle, paper_author, paper_doi, two-level categories, use_math), all math in $$, display blocks blank-line separated (L140-142, L185), no H1, real tables. Deductions: heading L221 '상위 20개 엣지·노드만 넣는 평가 프로토콜' covers both experiments though DMR uses top 10 (L233); one-sentence restatement paragraphs L271, L302; English heading '### References' (L328).
score_notes.B: Mostly natural 입니다 register, no noun frames or calques found. Deductions: L227 says the Zep-only network latency three times in one paragraph ('추가 네트워크 지연을 더했고 ... 기준선 평가에는 없었다 ... 그래서 이 구간의 네트워크 지연은 Zep 쪽에만 더해졌습니다'); L269 '가상의 예로 설명하면, 짧은 컨텍스트가 정확도를 높일 수 있는 이유는 앞서 든 이사 예시로 그려 볼 수 있습니다' -> '짧은 컨텍스트가 왜 도움이 될 수 있는지 이사 예시로 그려 보겠습니다'; L171 repeats '주기적인 전체 갱신이 여전히 필요' twice in one paragraph; '가상의' 10 times and '할 수 있습니다' 8 times; formulaic '표에서 볼 수 있듯이' (L62).
score_notes.C: L223 '절차는 두 실험에서 같습니다 ... 엣지 20개와 엔티티 노드 20개' contradicts L233 'Zep은 ... 상위 10개씩 꺼냈습니다 ... 두 실험의 설정이 이 부분에서 다릅니다' without flagging the paper's own inconsistency; repeated 'not verified by the paper' disclaimers (L269, L271, L300 twice, L304) read as stitched fragments; L302 restates L279.
score_notes.D: Running move-example helps the bi-temporal and invalidation parts (L81-88, L144), but it is reused about ten times, including where it adds nothing (L225, L248 'DMR은 "지금 어디 살지?"처럼 ...', L300); trivial label-propagation vote gets prose plus a table (L158-167).
score_notes.E: DMR, LongMemEval and question-type tables copy the source cell for cell; pipeline table (L98-103) and layer table (L56-60) help. The vote table (L162-167) duplicates L158; no reference by paper figure numbers.
score_notes.F: No fabricated numbers; all three result tables match. Deductions: L314 attaches the paper's 'less capable models' understanding of Zep's temporal data' remark (said about knowledge-update / gpt-4o-mini) to the single-session-assistant drop; L265 states '최대 18.5% 향상은 상대 향상률입니다' as fact though the paper does not say so and 60.2->71.2 computes to 18.3%; L125 presents the paper's own claim ('prevents erroneous combinations of similar edges between different entities') as '필자가 보기에'; L267 calls the latency column '평균' though the paper does not say mean or median (an IQR column suggests median).
score_notes.R1: Covers construction (episodes, entities, facts, temporal extraction, communities), retrieval (search, rerankers, constructor), both experiments and limitations with real detail.
score_notes.R2: Mechanism -> reason -> formula -> example order for invalidation (L129-146) and label propagation (L148-167); length is long for a short systems paper with padding from the repeated example.
score_notes.R3: TL;DR answers four questions with model-scoped numbers (L28-30); closing gives own assessment (missing ablation, no RAG baseline, ingestion cost, L320-324). Deduction: '논문이 밝힌 한계' list mislinks a paper statement (L314).

claim_headings.evidence: L34 '정적 RAG와 통째로 넣는 컨텍스트가 놓치는 변하는 사실', L229, L252; L221 heading is inaccurate for DMR.

running_example.evidence: Busan->Seoul move used across ingestion, invalidation, retrieval, results (L36, L144, L213, L269); overused.

mechanism_choice_formula_example.evidence: Edge invalidation L129-146 (rule, formula L140-142, worked example L144); label propagation L150-167.

facts_said_once.evidence: Network latency x3 in L227; L279 restated by L302; L269 restated by L271; periodic refresh L154 and twice in L171.

numbers_with_scope_unit.evidence: Numbers carry model and benchmark (L28, L260-263); L265 asserts 18.5% is relative without the 18.3% computed check; L267 '평균' latency.

nothing_invented.evidence: Hypotheticals labelled ('가상의', '필자가 만든'); L314 mislinks a paper statement; L125 misattributes a paper claim to the writer.

writers_assessment_at_end.evidence: L320 '여기서부터는 이 글의 견해입니다' (no ablation, no vector-RAG baseline, ingestion cost), L324 when to adopt.

length_fitted_to_difficulty.evidence: About 51 KB for a short engineering paper; repeated example and disclaimers inflate L225, L248, L269-271, L300-304.

type_specific_shape.evidence: Review: TL;DR four questions, 한계와 시사점 closing; guide/survey rules n/a.

korean_style.evidence: 입니다 register kept; repetition of '가상의' (10), '할 수 있습니다' (8), repeated disclaimer sentences.

sampling: Body paragraphs (blank-line blocks after TL;DR headings, excluding headings) numbered from line 36; took paragraphs 1, 4, 7, ... 91 and drew the 15 claims from the factual ones among them.
